definitions.gloss: to negotiate; to bargain; to enter into talks
definitions.explanation: To discuss terms in order to reach an agreement. Used in business, diplomacy, labor relations, and everyday situations.

examples.japanese: {給料|きゅうりょう}について{交渉|こうしょう}する。
{労働組合|ろうどうくみあい}が{会社|かいしゃ}と{交渉|こうしょう}している。
examples.english: The labor union is negotiating with the company.

examples.japanese: {値段|ねだん}を{交渉|こうしょう}して、もう{少|すこ}し{安|やす}くしてもらった。
examples.english: I negotiated the price and got it a little cheaper.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for both formal negotiations (business deals, diplomacy) and informal bargaining (haggling at a market). The noun {交渉|こうしょう} often appears on its own in compound expressions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {交渉|こうしょう}する (to negotiate)
- {交渉|こうしょう}が{成立|せいりつ}する (negotiations are concluded)
- {交渉|こうしょう}が{決裂|けつれつ}する (negotiations break down)
- {交渉|こうしょう}{相手|あいて} (negotiating partner)
- {交渉|こうしょう}{力|りょく} (negotiating power)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {話|はな}し{合|あ}う: to discuss — broader, less formal
- {折衝|せっしょう}する: to negotiate — more formal, used in business and politics
